newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas says foreigners hold 50.38 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas says foreigners hold 50.38 pct.

text.p: Foreign shareholders now own 50.38 percent of shares in Qantas Airways Ltd, exceeding the 49 percent limit for foreign shareholdings, Qantas said.

"Qantas will investigate the recent foreign purchases and ... should the level of foreign ownership on the Qantas Foreign Sub-Register exceed 49%, the Qantas Articles contain provisions to notify those foreign shareholders," Qantas said.

"Should such a notice be required to be sent, it results in the registered holder of the offending shares not being entitled to vote the shares at a meeting of shareholders and it may lead to the disposal of those shares," Qantas said.
